aboutMore: things that aren't gaps: i've been through 6 decks and 5 of them have names and a funeral (see blog). my mom works nights at the hospital and leaves a note on the fridge before she goes. today's said ICE. ELEVATE. DO NOT TELL ME HOW MANY STAIRS. i follow the first two. my sister tess is 20 and lives in columbus and sends me a birthday card every year with a skateboard on it. it's a snowboard. every year. i have all four. i've never told her. i'm never going to tell her.

blog.title: FUNERAL SERVICES FOR DECKS 1 THROUGH 5 (a program)
blog.body: deck 1 (Brenda): garage sale, $9. lasted 2 months. cause of death: a curb. deck 2 (Lucille): snapped on the 4 stair at the library, mike's stairs. i went back and apologized to the stairs. deck 3 (The Bruise): had a skull on it. that skull saw things. lost to the loading dock. deck 4 (Nice One): bought the week the shop guy said nice one. cracked on its first landing. i wasn't even mad. deck 5 (no name): we don't talk about deck 5. a hose was involved. deck 6 (Big Gap): current. 4 months old. nose like a pencil. holding. i've asked it to hold. in lieu of flowers please send grip tape. raul at the shop says every board has 'a number of landings' in it and u should 'spend them on stuff u care about.' so i spent 3 on a hose. i think that's the most sensible thing anyone has ever said to me and also i'm still not sorry.

blog.title: the shop guy has a name and it's raul (a development)
blog.body: i have been going to the shop for 3 months and thinking about 'nice one' since june 12. today i finally asked his name. it's raul. he said it like it's just a name. he's been raul this whole time. i said 'hey raul' and he said 'hey' and then he said 'you're the safeway kid.' I'M THE SAFEWAY KID. i've been SEEN. he's heard about the hose. he says the hose is 'the right amount of ridiculous.' then he watched me kickflip a rail in the parking lot and said 'you fall like somebody who's going to keep skating.' he gave me a free sheet of grip tape and said 'don't tell mike.' HE KNOWS MIKE. mike has been going there 2 years and has never been given free grip tape. i'm not saying it's a sponsorship. i'm saying i have a name and a sheet of tape and that's about 60% of one.

blog.title: why my ollie works (science) (ms tran explained it)
blog.body: so i've been going to ms. tran's physics club on thursdays at 3:15 (donuts, 5 kids, a sub who just sits there). i asked her one question: why does the board follow my feet in an ollie. she put down her marker and said 'oh. oh, this is a good one.' then she talked for 40 minutes. i have 2 pages of notes. short version: the tail hits the ground and the ground pushes back (newton's third law), my front foot slides up and drags the board along by friction, and it levels out when the weight is even. i've been doing physics since i was 12 and calling it 'trying.' she helped me measure the gap with the angle thing. 4 feet 1. evan got 3'11 and skip got 4'3, so that's three witnesses and three sizes. i asked all of them to say 11. none would. they're very honest. it's annoying. but now i have a formula and mike has a bush.

blog.title: teaching henry how to fall (progress report #1)
blog.body: henry is 13. he has wheels in his shoes and he's banned from 3 stores. he was in lakewood for his cousin's birthday and asked his cousin to take him to see 'the safeway kid.' i said heelys are real. he looked like i'd handed him a trophy. i also said he needed pads. he came back wearing his mom's oven mitts. we upgraded (wrist guards, knee pads, a helmet with flames). lesson 1: how to fall. tuck your chin, roll to your shoulder, never put your hand out. i demonstrated 9 times. henry demonstrated 14 times and said 'ow' 11 of them. when he rolled out of the last one clean i said 'nice one' out loud before i could stop myself and he stood there like somebody had flipped a switch. gordon, the safeway manager, watched from the door and gave a thumbs up. i've never had a student. it's different from having a gap. nobody tells u about the part where you're scared for them.

survey.title: the 'what kind of skater r u' survey (these r just my answers) (mike's are wrong)
qa: board:
deck 6, 'Big Gap.' 4 months old. holding
stance:
regular. mike skates goofy. he says it's a stance. i say it's a situation
biggest thing u've cleared:
the safeway gap. 4 feet 1 inch of air plus a hose and a bucket (the bucket is new). i say 11 for emphasis
worst injury:
split chin, 6 stitches. the doctor asked what happened and i said 'a hose.' he said 'a hose?' i said 'it was on.' (it wasn't on)
best sound in the world:
wheels on fresh asphalt. the whole parking lot sounds like one long breath
heroes:
tony hawk, raul, and my mom, who works all night and still checks my shins
what's in ur backpack:
wrist guards, a skate tool, an empty bag of frozen peas (for later), a library book i've had since june
one trick u can't do:
switch anything. when i go switch the board looks at me like a stranger
favorite thing about the safeway:
the loading dock, the slope, the hose, gordon's wave, and the free sample lady on saturdays (cheese, always)
pets:
a cat named Nollie. he is lazy. he is not a skater
something mike doesn't know:
i made him a birthday card with a bush on it. it was supposed to be a mean card. it came out nice. i kept it. i'm not giving it to him
what do u want to be in 10 years:
the guy at the shop who says 'nice one' to a kid. that's the job. i checked
describe urself in one sentence:
i fall down more than anyone u know and i'm always back up before the peas thaw

dms: malten my mom called me from her break at the hospital to ask if the landing was clean. she never asks if it was big. she asks if it was clean. i said it was clean. she said 'ok' and went back to work. best phone call of the week
a guy walking out of the safeway with a rotisserie chicken stopped and clapped for my manual. 4 seconds. he didn't have to. he had a chicken. best audience i've ever had
do wheels get tired. serious question. mine are 4 months old and they've seen things. i'm thinking about retiring them to the shelf. next to a shoe mike lost in june that i have never given back
i got a haircut. 40% shorter. now my helmet doesn't fit. my mom says that's what helmets are for. i don't think that's what helmets are for

tess called from columbus. she asked if i'm eating real food. i said 'peas.' she said 'derek.' then she asked if i cleared the gap and i said yes and she said 'on tape?' and i said no and she said 'that's ok, i believe you.' she's the only one who says it like that. mike says 'prove it.'

ms tran asked me to explain an ollie to the whole physics club thursday. 5 kids and a sub. i used a pencil and a ruler. a kid named theo took notes. somebody asked if a rock could ollie. i said 'if it believes.' ms tran wrote that down. i think i teach physics now
gordon the safeway manager left a box of bruised bananas by the loading dock with a sign that says SKATERS. i've never felt so accepted by an institution

the first thing i do after every fall is look around. not for pain. for witnesses. if there's a witness it counts as a bail. if there's not it's just something that happened to me. so if u ever see me fall please stay. it's an honor system

malten be honest. is it weird that i've been saying 'nice one' to everybody all week. i said it to a mailbox. i said it to a guy parallel parking. raul says it and it works. when i say it people look worried

i found out the hose belongs to the safeway. gordon said 'oh the hose. yeah. i wondered where that was getting moved to.' he's been moving it back every night. i've been moving it out every morning. we've never discussed it. we both just keep going
